reviewer: research-director (Opus); recorded by the main session (Sonnet)
decision: accept as report-only; reading 'not informative at this support'; no dashboard, no article
owner_decision: 2026-11-25 (Andrii, chat): 'Before/after look around the 26 July top-up: We can do this.'

scale_decision.quote: You may trust the data since it is plausible and according to my manual control. So the pressure is assumed to be correct.

allowed_wording: M773 before/after look at one tyre top-up: the covariate-adjusted difference in battery-side electric-driving energy (engine-speed proxy at most 400 rpm) is +1.16 kWh per 100 km [-0.88, 3.25] (60 drives on 19 days before, 56 on 18 days after; MDE 2.95), about 70 times the half-MDE threshold of 0.042: not informative at this support
the sign is opposite to the pre-registered expectation (-0.7 % to -5.3 %) and the interval includes zero
the placebo windows reach about 3 kWh per 100 km: the scale of the season, route, HVAC and load confounding, larger than both the observed and the expected change
the sensitivities span +0.28 to +1.69 (regen-poor subset -0.65); nothing is picked
forbidden: pressure effect, no effect, no pressure effect
quotable_now: the 42-day window only together with the primary, as a sensitivity: +1.54 with a lower bound of 0.09 (author) or 0.02 (audit), i.e. at zero and implementation sensitive; read as inconsistent with the expected sign, confounding suspected, never as a finding

placebo -42 days: about -3.1 [about -6.0, about 0.0] (the upper bound falls either side of zero: no inclusion or exclusion statement); placebo +42 days +0.8 to +1.0 (implementation difference unresolved): magnitudes of confounding only
pressure dose (cold-equivalent medians): before 235 to 239 kPa; week +1 261 kPa (4 drives); weeks +2 to +4 247 to 249 kPa
deviations_to_state: the eligible-drive mean is 12.10 kWh per 100 km (445 drives), not the 14.2 of the spec text (645 channel drives): the half-MDE threshold is 0.042
the offset-covariate sensitivity is degenerate (every resample rank deficient; the estimate equals the primary): report it as non-estimable
the winsorised sensitivity was added after the audit (post hoc, labelled)
placebo centres skipped by the guard: 28 days +56 and +84, 14 days +84; several centres are counts only
the realised sustained dose is about +4 to +6 %, below the assumed 10 to 16 %, so the expected change is smaller still
one drive differs in the long-soak gap between a local-time and a UTC basis (DST)
the EV mean speed fell from 34.9 to 32.2 km/h across the step (an observation, not an explanation)
follow_ups: reconcile the author and audit placebo +42 days and the 42-day lower bound (seed, resample or covariate path); low priority
fix or drop the offset covariate (collinear) in the tool
fix the long-soak flag to one time basis
no further top-up looks on this channel unless the effect is designed (paired, many steps)
